summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Mini Golf USA clone. All 23 pytest backend tests passed (public routes, filters, search, auth, CRUD, content update). Frontend home page renders hero from /api/content, featured grid (3), popular cities (12), top-rated (12), 50 state links. Header search 'tiki' shows dropdown and click navigates to course page. States index, StatePage FL, city chips, TopRated Load More button all present. Admin flow verified end-to-end: unauth redirect, wrong creds error, login with admin/admin123, dashboard stats (151 courses), create course modal + save, search, delete (dialog auto-accepted), content update reflected on home hero, restore, logout redirect.
critical_code_review_comments: Login rate-limit identifier uses client.host + username — behind a proxy/ingress this is likely the ingress IP shared by many users; consider using X-Forwarded-For header.

CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins default '*' is invalid per CORS spec (browsers will reject). Currently works because frontend uses Bearer token, not cookies, but should either set explicit origins or disable credentials.

seed_data.py imports random and uses random.choice at module import time inside _course via random.choice (called inside build_courses under fixed seed — OK). Minor: seeding depends on state city order; deterministic seed=42 keeps it stable.

GET /api/content returns raw doc; if 'key' field is stored, it is filtered via response_model (SiteContent) — good, but the doc lookup relies on NO_ID projection only; response_model strips extras. OK.
Admin delete uses window.confirm; consider replacing with a styled modal for consistency.
seed_data_creation: None. Test data (TEST_UI_Course, TEST_Course_Alpha) created during tests were cleaned up. Verified via API count=0 with q=TEST_. Hero title restored to 'Your Next Adventure'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, runs via pytest with junit output to /app/test_reports/pytest/. Base URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin login uses username+password (lowercased). Brute-force lockout after 5 attempts / 15 min — use non-existent username for negative auth tests. Frontend test-ids follow pattern hero-title, featured-grid, popular-cities-grid, top-rated-grid, state-link-{code}, header-search-input, header-search-results, course-title, admin-tab-courses, admin-tab-content, add-course-button, course-form-modal/name/city/state/submit, admin-course-search, edit-course-{id}, toggle-featured-{id}, delete-course-{id}, content-hero-title1, save-content-button, admin-logout-button, login-username-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, login-error, stat-total-courses. Search dropdown items are <button> elements (not <a>).
